commands.label: full-extension-file-hashes
argv:
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
def inventory(raw):
 p=Path(raw)
 return {str(x.relative_to(p)):{"bytes":x.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for x in sorted(p.rglob("*")) if x.is_file()}
a,b=map(inventory,sys.argv[1:3])
print(json.dumps({"produced":a,"installed":b,"byte_equal_file_inventory":a==b},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

commands.label: bounded-static-observations
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
for name in ["symbol-review.stdout","objc-review.stdout","platform-review.stdout"]:
 lines=(p/name).read_text().splitlines()
 if name=="symbol-review.stdout": keep=[x for x in lines if "OBJC_CLASS" in x or "OBJC_METACLASS" in x]
 elif name=="objc-review.stdout": keep=[x for x in lines if "name " in x and ("RevocationFileProvider" in x or "NSFileProviderReplicatedExtension" in x)]
 else: keep=[x for x in lines if "platform " in x or "minos " in x or "sdk " in x]
 print(name+"\n"+"\n".join(keep))
